title: TXTL Phage Production Protocol
author: Marijn Ceelen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.77thrnn

steps.title: Calculate and Prepare Reaction Components
steps.instruction: Prepare the TXTL reaction mixture with a total recommended volume of 12 µL, ensuring the sample is RNase free.

substeps.instruction: Set TXTL master mix to 3/4 of the total reaction volume.
Add PEG-8000 to a concentration of 3%.
Add GamS to a concentration of 3.3 µM.
Add dNTPs to a concentration of 0.5 mM.
Add the DNA of choice and MQ water to fill the remaining volume.
For phage T7, use a recommended DNA concentration of 0.25 nM (though concentrations as low as 0.04 nM may work).
If using GFP as a positive control, use the Arbor Biosciences GFP plasmid (with a sigma 70 promoter) at a concentration of 5 nM.

steps.title: Assemble and Seal Reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette the ingredients together in either Eppendorf tubes or 96-well plates.

substeps.instruction: If using a 96-well plate, seal the plate properly to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Incubate Mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction mixture at 30 °C for 12 to 16 hours.

steps.title: Verify Phage Production
steps.instruction: Perform a plaque assay to check for phage production.
